info.name: Docusign Returns information about the users in an organization.

params.name: organizationId
params.description: The organization ID Guid

params.name: start
params.description: Index of first item to include in the response. The default value is 0.

params.name: take
params.description: Page size of the response. The default value is 20.

params.name: end
params.description: Index of the last item to include in the response. Ignored if `take` parameter is specified.

params.name: email
params.description: Email address of the desired user. At least one of `email`, `account_id` or `organization_reserved_domain_id` must be specified.

params.name: email_user_name_like
params.description: Selects users by pattern matching on the user's email address

params.name: status
params.description: Status.

params.name: membership_status
params.description:
The user's membership status. One of:

- `activation_required`
- `activation_sent`
- `active`
- `closed`
- `disabled`

params.name: account_id
params.description: Select users that are members of the specified account. At least one of `email`, `account_id` or `organization_reserved_domain_id` must be specified.

params.name: organization_reserved_domain_id
params.description: Select users that are in the specified domain. At least one of `email`, `account_id` or `organization_reserved_domain_id` must be specified.

params.name: last_modified_since
params.description: Select users whose data have been modified since the date specified. `account_id` or `organization_reserved_domain_id` must be specified.

items.docs:
Returns information about the users in an organization.


- Required scopes: `user_read`

You must include at least one of the following query parameters in the request:

- `account_id`: The id of an account associated with the organization.
- `organization_reserved_domain_id`: The id of one of the organization's reserved domains.
- `email`: An email address associated with the users that you want to return.

info.name: Docusign Retrieves the list of users for the specified account.

params.name: accountId
params.description: The external account number (int) or account id GUID.

params.name: additional_info
params.description: When set to **true**, the full list of user information is returned for each user in the account.

params.name: count
params.description: Number of records to return. The number must be greater than 0 and less than or equal to 100.

params.name: email_substring
params.description: Filters the returned user records by the email address or a sub-string of email address.

params.name: group_id
params.description: Filters user records returned by one or more group Id's.

params.name: start_position
params.description: Starting value for the list.

params.name: status
params.description:
Filters the user records by account status. One of:

* ActivationRequired
* ActivationSent
* Active
* Closed
* Disabled

params.name: user_name_substring
params.description: Filters the user records returned by the user name or a sub-string of user name.

items.docs:
Retrieves the list of users for the specified account.

The response returns the list of users for the account along with the information about the result set. If the `additional_info` query was added to the endpoint and set to **true**, the full user information is returned for each user

items.docs:
Removes the specified user from the specified account.

## Permissions

To remove a user who has a lower access level, you must have the `canRemoveCompanyMemberLowerAccessLevel` permission set to **true.** 

To remove a user who has the same access level, you must have the `canRemoveCompanyMemberSameAccessLevel` permission set to **true.**

Retrieves the user profile picture for the specified user. The image is returned in the same format as uploaded.

The userId parameter specified in the endpoint must match the authenticated user's user ID and the user must be a member of the specified account.

If successful, the response returns a 200 - OK and the user profile image.

Updates the user profile image by uploading an image to the user profile.

The supported image formats are: gif, png, jpeg, and bmp. The file must be less than 200K. For best viewing results, DocuSign recommends that the image is no more than 79 pixels wide and high.

Invitations expire after 30 days and can no longer be accepted. Use this method to send a new copy of an invitation to a pending user.
